role: Only writer of the kit. Children copy. Alumni take a drop. Portable intakes absorb.
refuse: BOARD.md or board.json from a child
Real people, pay, or client data
A direct write to VirBk/virbk from a child remote
A factory overlay onto Otto or Virbos without a kit pin and owner word

children.name: Otto
children.take: Envelope, landing gate, keystones, idle-is-success, real-data gates, closed owner-ask, ruling-fits-hold. Alumni drop after O38 is a size check on Otto's own gate plus archive (D-30). A drop that grows over-cap files is pain (T52).

drop.note: Second dated drop appended 2026-09-22: a gate that cannot run its shell names it and exits, instead of reporting every step red. expect still names the FIRST drop's files, because the second lands in whatever executes that product's steps and this factory has not seen that file - naming a path it has not opened is what T76 exists to stop. drop-status therefore measures the size check only; adoption of the second is the product control plane's own report.

children.name: Virbos
children.take: Decision register, authority levels, walkthrough as acceptance, derivation containers. Alumni drop after PK-3b and LEAVE-TYPE-KEY is a size check on Virbos's own gate plus archive (D-31). A drop that grows over-cap files is pain (T52).

drop.note: Second dated drop appended 2026-09-22: a gate that cannot run its shell names it and exits, instead of reporting every step red. expect still names the FIRST drop's files, because the second lands in whatever executes that product's steps and this factory has not seen that file - naming a path it has not opened is what T76 exists to stop. drop-status therefore measures the size check only; adoption of the second is the product control plane's own report.

children.name: Next child
children.take: Does not exist until this kit is copied into a new product remote.

intakes.title: Envelope as the only authorization
intakes.charged: Work that started from continue could not be verified.
intakes.rule: No envelope, no code. One page: acceptance, base SHA, holds, check.
intakes.check: Landing refuses a branch whose return does not cite an envelope id.

intakes.title: SESSION_LOG.md as a living file
intakes.charged: Newest-first essays. Nobody could hand off from it.
intakes.rule: Do not create SESSION_LOG.md. Lane logs are a few lines. History is git.
intakes.check: Size budget and a landing-gate glob fail any SESSION_LOG.md.

intakes.title: BOARD.md as hand-edited markdown
intakes.charged: Invented clocks, backticks, f-string braces. Files grew past a sitting.
intakes.rule: factory/board.json is the source. BOARD.md is generated.
intakes.check: renderBoard.mjs --check fails a landing if the markdown drifted.

intakes.title: Gate reads the working tree, tests the commit
intakes.charged: Same SHA gated as different step counts in two trees.
intakes.rule: Parse the check list from a fresh git archive of the commit under test.
intakes.check: landingGate.mjs exits 1 if factory/landing-checks.json is missing from the archive.

intakes.title: Idle is success
intakes.charged: Filling seats created overlapping holds. Conflict resolution is unreviewed code.
intakes.rule: Two writers is a ceiling, not a target. Empty seats stay empty.
intakes.check: The board names disjoint holds before a second sibling launches.

intakes.title: Copied counts in prose
intakes.charged: README quoted rule counts that were wrong by the time they were read.
intakes.rule: Paste from the command that produced the number, with the command, or omit.
intakes.check: Landing gate forbids digits in README/AGENTS/BOARD except in generated tables.

intakes.title: Control plane session pointed at a cheap model
intakes.charged: The harness looked the same. Judgment did not.
intakes.rule: Spawn a writer seat. Do not remap the control-plane session.
intakes.check: Envelope names a runtime. A writer return whose model equals the CP is a stop.

intakes.title: Control plane was a Claude Code window
intakes.charged: A laptop without Anthropic and a cloud Grok session could not run the loop.
intakes.rule: Judgment is Grok or Claude. Hands are a dumb runner. Writer harness is a PM pick in factory/project.json.
intakes.check: hands.mjs --self-test fails a project.json whose pick is not in runtimes.json.

intakes.title: Token-zero treated as no-scope
intakes.charged: A queue name was stamped absent because a markdown-only grep missed the wave table in the same board and the product source.
intakes.rule: A ZERO names every container, including empty ones. Product source is a container. The board's later sections are a container.
intakes.check: node factory/tools/scopeSearch.mjs --self-test fails if a token that lives only in source is reported absent.

intakes.title: Named issuance asked of the owner
intakes.charged: A lane sat blocked on the citation while the board already named the section of the official PDF.
intakes.rule: A named law, circular, IRR, RFC, or PDF is a fetch. Quote it or stamp the miss. Asking the owner is for documents that do not exist.
intakes.check: CONTROL_PLANE.md is required CP reading. A blocked-on-issuance ledger row without a fetch URL is a diary.

intakes.title: Collection treated as no statute
intakes.charged: Practice still collecting was read as missing law, so the lane could not start.
intakes.rule: An agency still collecting is a second fact. Transcribe the issuance. Do not collapse practice into no legal basis.
intakes.check: CONTROL_PLANE.md requires both facts stamped. The issuance URL is in the ledger row.

intakes.title: Tool-policy refusal treated as owner wait
intakes.charged: A correction envelope sat unlaunched because Start-Process was refused, and hours waited on a click.
intakes.rule: A refused launch is not an owner ask. Binary underneath, then hands launch, then print the one-line and split. Do not wait.
intakes.check: node factory/tools/ownerAsk.mjs --self-test fails if CONTROL_PLANE.md does not name tool-policy and hands launch.

intakes.title: Ruling that cannot fit the hold
intakes.charged: Two halves were ruled then scoped out of the issued lane, so both were owed rather than dropped.
intakes.rule: Before issue, every sentence of the ruling is implementable in the named holds. Split what cannot.
intakes.check: CONTROL_PLANE.md section on ruling and hold. Envelope holds are the bound. A lane whose other half is owed is a control-plane defect.

intakes.title: Green gate quoted as the whole check
intakes.charged: A gate line was quoted at four landings as if it had run a suite it does not contain.
intakes.rule: A landing line names which check covered what. A green gate is not evidence about a suite it does not contain.
intakes.check: landing-checks.json note says the gate is these steps only. CONTROL_PLANE.md requires the integration run named or named as not run.

intakes.title: Negative finding stamped without a drive
intakes.charged: A seat return looked like a drive and entered a register row without one command against the classes.
intakes.rule: A seat return that looks like a drive is a lead until the control plane runs one command at the objects.
intakes.check: CONTROL_PLANE.md. A register row that cites a seat return as fact must name the command the control plane ran.

intakes.title: Eureka left in the transcript
intakes.charged: A sitting's lesson died at the fuse because git had no quarantine short of a trap.
intakes.rule: Mid-sitting, spark.mjs add. Successor looks at factory/sparks.json. Absorbing is an envelope with a check. Do not write handoff.md.
intakes.check: node factory/tools/spark.mjs --self-test fails if CONTROL_PLANE.md does not say look, not law.

intakes.title: Session-only waiver inherited as law
intakes.charged: A temporary approval restamped onto AGENTS or waited as if it were standing policy.
intakes.rule: A waiver is the envelope or gitignored factory/.waiver. Sitting close expires it. Never BOARD, never traps.
intakes.check: node factory/tools/spark.mjs --self-test fails if factory/.waiver is tracked or present in the archive.

intakes.title: Absorbed references are not live children
intakes.charged: Relabeling Otto and Virbos as kit children would stop open keystone lanes and merge boards into the parent.
intakes.rule: Alumni take a dated drop after running seats finish. They file intakes. They do not copy the kit over a live product. Overlay is a later envelope with a pin.
intakes.check: factory/drops/ names otto and virbos. lineage status is alumni. COPY.md refuses retrofit. A child remote is still the empty next.

intakes.title: Private session notes used as the record
intakes.charged: The Otto control plane asked the owner to delete a branch already gone because Claude memory was stale.
intakes.rule: The repository is the record. Session notes, Claude memory, and handoff files are not.
intakes.check: CONTROL_PLANE.md names the repository as the record and session notes as not. T50. A fact taken from notes is a diary.

intakes.title: Closed keystone list skipped then cited as precedent
intakes.charged: Three Otto envelopes named neither keystone nor challenge; one touched mapping; the skip was then cited as the rule.
intakes.rule: A closed keystone list is read at issue. Every writer envelope names the keystone or its absence. Recent skips are not precedent.
intakes.check: CONTROL_PLANE.md requires the keystone named at issue. T51. An envelope that omits it is a diary.

intakes.title: Alumni drop without a check
intakes.charged: The evening Otto drop and the morning Virbos drop would have grown over-cap live files with no landing failure.
intakes.rule: A drop is a check that product's existing gate runs, or archive first. Do not append to an over-cap live file.
intakes.check: factory/drops/otto.md names the size step on landingChecks.yml. factory/drops/virbos.md names it on tools/check.yml. T52. D-30 D-31. A drop that only mints prose is a diary.

intakes.title: Size archive issued on the product path
intakes.charged: A ceiling split in the middle of a keystone landing waits delivery on a docs cut.
intakes.rule: The size script fails; it does not split. Archive at 80% is a CP records commit between landings. First cut is Now-only. Do not issue a writer.
intakes.check: factory/drops/otto.md and virbos.md name 80% between landings and Now-only as the first cut. T53. D-32. A writer envelope whose hold is a board archive is a diary.

provenance: Every absorbed portable intake names the law it became in absorbedAs: a trap id, or a file and section. node factory/tools/alumni.mjs provenance prints the chain.
